Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for the regular Class C knowledge test, in English; the skid steering rule [A03] and the crash reporting threshold [A04] are frequent recall items.
Level: procedure sequences for mechanical emergencies plus legal duties after a crash; scenario drills fit blowouts, skids and shoulder recovery.
Prerequisites: the vehicle equipment section (ABS, flashers, tires) and the insurance section, since crash reports can require proof of liability insurance.
Sensitivity: emergency responses are safety-critical and the post-crash duties are legal requirements; both are stated as printed.
